Bring your game

Install the port

  1. Update PortMaster. Copy SpaceGrunts2.zip into its autoinstall/ folder and open PortMaster.
  2. Allow PortMaster to download Java 17 and Westonpack. An internet connection is needed if these runtimes are not installed.
  3. Copy the owned game files into spacegrunts2/ as described above. Launch Space Grunts 2 from your ports menu.
Manual installation paths

1. Update PortMaster. Put SpaceGrunts2.zip in PortMaster's autoinstall/ directory, then open PortMaster to install it. Connect to the network to download Java 17 and Westonpack if they are not installed yet. 2. Copy the owned file to <ports directory>/spacegrunts2/spacegrunts2.dat. 3. Launch Space Grunts 2 from your firmware's ports menu.

For manual installation on muOS, extract the ZIP on your computer and copy Space Grunts 2.sh to <SD card>/roms/PORTS/, and the spacegrunts2/ folder to <SD card>/ports/ on the card configured as the firmware's ports location. The required file is <SD card>/ports/spacegrunts2/spacegrunts2.dat.

For ArkOS/dArkOS and standard ports layouts, extract the ZIP into your configured ports directory (for example /roms/ports/ or /roms2/ports/) so Space Grunts 2.sh and spacegrunts2/ are beside each other. Use the firmware's configured ports location; the launcher uses PortMaster's directory value. Avoid creating an extra SpaceGrunts2/ wrapper folder.

Saves & troubleshooting

Back up spacegrunts2/saves/ before updates. Read spacegrunts2/log.txt if startup fails. Report your device, exact firmware version, resolution and steps to reproduce, and attach the log. Test menu navigation, gameplay, audio, game speed, save/reload, suspend/resume and clean exit. Keep purchased game files private.
